components.name: IERC20
components.purpose: Minimal ERC20 interface (balanceOf, transfer, transferFrom). No approve/decimals.

components.name: SimplePair
components.purpose: Minimal constant-product token0/token1 pair, one-directional swap (token0 in, token1 out), no fee, no LP minting; used as LendingPool's spot price source.

components.name: LendingPool
components.purpose: Deposit token0 as collateral, borrow token1 up to 75% LTV valued at SimplePair spot reserves ratio. No interest, no liquidation.

components.name: ShareVault
components.purpose: ERC4626-like pooled vault; shares track a single asset, totalAssets = live balanceOf.

components.name: RewardPool
components.purpose: Synthetix-style staking: stake stakeToken, earn rewardToken at owner-set global rate.

components.name: PayoutSplitter
components.purpose: Holds a token and pushes its full balance to a fixed recipient list by bps shares; permissionless trigger.

roles.notes: owner has essentially nothing to protect: the only security-critical setter, setPair (L22-24), has NO modifier and is callable by anyone. setPair SHOULD be onlyOwner (or immutable).
No owner; sync permissionless (normal for UniV2 but makes donation-based price moves trivial).
Owner can set a rate that overflows rewardPerToken, bricking withdraw/claim (stake funds locked). No emergency withdraw. Nobody is required to fund rewardToken.
owner stored but unused; recipients/shares immutable after construction.

trust_boundaries.description: LendingPool trusts pair.getReserves() from a pair address anyone can replace; a malicious pair returns arbitrary reserves (or reverts).
Spot reserves as oracle; reserves are set from live balanceOf by permissionless sync(), so donations move price in one tx (no TWAP).
Collateral/debt token transfers; credited amounts assume no fee-on-transfer.
totalAssets() = asset.balanceOf(this): direct donations change share price.
asset transferFrom/transfer; fee-on-transfer would over-credit shares.
stakeToken/rewardToken transfers; if stakeToken==rewardToken, rewards are paid from stakers' principal.
Pushes tokens to fixed external recipient addresses; one failing/blacklisted recipient reverts the whole loop.
swap0For1 sends token1 to user-supplied `to` before sync(); input detection relies on balance delta vs stale reserve0.

asset_flows.enter: depositCollateral (token0), repay (token1); token1 liquidity must be pre-funded by direct transfer (no supply function)
asset_flows.held: token0 and token1 balances of pool
asset_flows.priced: price() = reserve1*1e18/reserve0 from pair (no decimal normalisation)

asset_flows.enter: direct transfers (token0 before swap; any donation)

asset_flows.priced: shares/assets ratio from totalSupply and live balance

asset_flows.enter: stake (stakeToken); rewardToken must be sent directly by someone

attack_surface.reason: Unprotected setter of the price source; anyone can point it at a fake pair and borrow the entire token1 balance.
Calls _updatePool but not _updateUser, so a new staker's userRewardPerTokenPaid stays 0 and they are credited all historic rewardPerToken.
Shares to burn rounded down (in user's favour); 0 shares can be burned for nonzero assets once share price > 1.
Spot-reserve oracle manipulable by donating token1 and calling sync, then recovering via swap0For1.
Classic first-depositor donation inflation; deposits that mint 0 shares are accepted.
Unbounded and unfunded; overflow in rewardPerToken bricks withdraw (principal lock), underfunding makes claim revert.
Push-payment loop; single reverting recipient freezes all funds forever (recipients immutable).
No liquidation path means bad debt is permanent; borrowers array grows with duplicates on re-borrow; r0==0 division reverts.

findings.title: Anyone can replace LendingPool price source via unprotected setPair
findings.mechanism: setPair has no onlyOwner modifier. price() trusts getReserves() of whatever pair is set.
attack_sequence: Deploy FakePair whose getReserves returns (1, type(uint112).max)
Optionally setPair back to the original
findings.impact: Total loss of all debtToken held by the pool; also anyone can set a reverting pair to freeze borrow/withdrawCollateral (DoS).
findings.how_to_validate: Foundry test: attacker-deployed mock pair, assert attacker token1 balance == pool's prior balance.

findings.title: New stakers earn rewards accrued before they staked (stake skips _updateUser)
findings.mechanism: stake() calls _updatePool() only; userRewardPerTokenPaid[user] stays at 0 (first stake) or at a stale value (top-ups), and rewards[user] is not checkpointed. earned() then computes staked*(rewardPerToken - 0), i.e. retroactive rewards on the full new balance.
attack_sequence: Fresh address stakes a large amount
Withdraw stake; repeat with new addresses
findings.impact: Theft of the reward token balance from honest stakers; insolvency of reward accounting.
findings.how_to_validate: Alice stakes, warp N seconds, Bob stakes same amount, Bob claims at once; assert Bob receives ~Alice's accrued reward.

findings.title: ShareVault.withdraw rounds burned shares down, allowing free withdrawals
findings.mechanism: shares = assets*totalSupply/totalAssets floors. When totalAssets > totalSupply (any yield/donation), withdraw(assets) with assets < totalAssets/totalSupply burns 0 shares yet transfers assets; in general each call underpays by up to 1 share.
attack_sequence: Ensure share price > 1 (donate or wait for others' deposits after a donation)
findings.impact: Drain of vault assets from other depositors (gas-bounded per call, unbounded with high share price).
findings.how_to_validate: Fuzz: after donation, call withdraw from an account with 0 shares; assert it succeeds and transfers assets.

findings.title: First-depositor share inflation in ShareVault
findings.mechanism: totalAssets is live balance and deposit accepts 0-share mints; attacker deposits 1 wei, donates X, victim deposit < X mints 0 shares; attacker redeems all.
attack_sequence: transfer X asset directly to vault
findings.how_to_validate: Standard inflation PoC; assert victim shares == 0.

findings.title: LendingPool uses manipulable spot reserves as collateral oracle
findings.mechanism: price = reserve1/reserve0 from a thin, permissionlessly-syncable pair. Donating token1 then sync() inflates collateral value; attacker borrows; donated token1 is then largely recoverable via swap0For1 (zero fee).
attack_sequence: Transfer large token1 to pair, call sync()
borrow max token1 at inflated price
swap0For1 to pull back donated token1 from the pair
Walk away with undercollateralised debt (no liquidation exists)
preconditions: Attacker capital or flash loan of token1
Pair liquidity small relative to pool
findings.impact: Bad debt / drain of pool token1.
findings.how_to_validate: Fork-free Foundry test measuring attacker net profit after recovering donation via swap0For1.

findings.title: RewardPool owner can brick withdrawals; rewards are unfunded promises
findings.mechanism: rate is unbounded; (dt*rate*1e18) overflows and reverts inside _updateUser, which withdraw calls, so principal can never be withdrawn. No check rewardToken balance covers emissions, so claim reverts when underfunded.
findings.how_to_validate: Set rate=type(uint256).max/1e18, warp 2s, expect withdraw revert.

findings.title: PayoutSplitter distribute freezes if any recipient transfer reverts
findings.mechanism: All-or-nothing push loop over immutable recipients; a blacklisted/zero-address-rejecting recipient reverts every distribution.
attack_sequence: Recipient becomes un-payable (token blacklist, address(0) with OZ token)
preconditions: Token with transfer restrictions or bad recipient at construction
findings.how_to_validate: Mock token reverting for one recipient; assert distribute reverts.

findings.title: LendingPool has no liquidation; borrowers array duplicates; zero-reserve DoS
findings.mechanism: Underwater positions can never be closed by others; borrowers.push on every re-borrow after full repay inflates borrowerCount; reserve0==0 makes price() revert, blocking withdrawCollateral even for debt-free users.
attack_sequence: borrow, repay fully, borrow again: duplicate entry
findings.impact: Bad debt accumulates; monitoring count wrong; DoS when pair empty.

notes: Small 6-file synthetic codebase, no tests or scripts. Most severe: LendingPool.setPair unprotected (L22), RewardPool.stake missing user checkpoint (L48-53), ShareVault.withdraw round-down (L36). Secondary: spot oracle, inflation attack, owner/recipient liveness. Minor: SimplePair uint112 truncating casts in sync (L18-19), no decimal normalisation in price(), fee-on-transfer assumptions throughout, PayoutSplitter.owner unused, ShareVault.redeem divides by zero when totalSupply==0 (L44).
